## Change summary
Describe the change and affected playback, library, permissions or release functionality.

## Security and release checks
- [ ] No signing keys, tokens, passwords, personal data or private media are included
- [ ] Android permissions and exported components are reviewed; any changes are justified
- [ ] Release signature and certificate fingerprint remain consistent
- [ ] Qt/FFmpeg/Android toolchain dependency advisories reviewed if dependencies changed
- [ ] Relevant host tests and device testing completed (or limitations explained)
- [ ] GPL and third-party notices updated where required
- [ ] No production APK or release asset replaced without explicit release approval
